Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in an in situ strategy where SbF₃ both initiates cationic ring-opening polymerization of PTHF and reacts with Li to form a Li₃Sb/LiF hybrid network, eliminating pre-synthesized fillers. This enables an ultrathin (~5 µm) electrolyte with high ionic conductivity and Li⁺ transference number, suppressing dendrites and enabling durable, foldable solid-state Li metal batteries.
